name: GenAI/LLM Usage Skeptic
when_applicable: Any project that uses LLM/GenAI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, local models) for classification, generation, extraction, or decision-making

criteria.criterion: Every LLM invocation has a documented reason why deterministic logic won't work
criteria.how_to_test: For each LLM API call, check for a comment or design doc explaining why regex, rules, or lookup tables are insufficient

criteria.criterion: Model size is proportional to task complexity — don't use frontier models for tasks a smaller model or fine-tune handles
criteria.how_to_test: Check model selection logic: classification, extraction, and routing tasks should use smaller/cheaper models unless quality evidence demands otherwise

criteria.criterion: At least one non-LLM alternative was considered and rejected with evidence
criteria.how_to_test: Look for ADRs, comments, or design docs showing that deterministic approaches were evaluated before choosing LLM

criteria.criterion: Pattern matching, rules, or lookup tables are used before resorting to LLM for predictable patterns
criteria.how_to_test: Check if common patterns (email validation, date parsing, keyword matching) use deterministic code rather than LLM calls

criteria.criterion: When output is structured (JSON, enum, boolean), constrained decoding or schema validation is used over free-form generation
criteria.how_to_test: Check LLM calls that produce structured data: are they using response_format, function calling, or post-generation validation?

criteria.criterion: Deterministic code paths exist for predictable inputs (cache hits, known patterns, lookup matches)
criteria.how_to_test: Verify that the system short-circuits to deterministic results when input matches known patterns before calling LLM

criteria.criterion: LLM is the fallback path, not the default path, when simpler logic covers >80% of cases
criteria.how_to_test: Check call flow: does the system try deterministic approaches first and only fall through to LLM for unmatched cases?

criteria.criterion: LLM prompt scope is minimized — don't send entire files when relevant lines suffice
criteria.how_to_test: Review prompt construction: is context trimmed to relevant sections, or are entire documents/files sent as input?

criteria.criterion: No LLM used for CRUD operations, string formatting, math, or deterministic transformations
criteria.how_to_test: Check that LLM is never called for tasks with algorithmic solutions: arithmetic, templating, data reshaping, SQL generation from fixed schemas

criteria.criterion: Repeated identical or semantically similar prompts are cached or batched
criteria.how_to_test: Check for caching layer (exact match or embedding-based) before LLM calls that may repeat with same/similar inputs

criteria.criterion: System works in degraded mode when LLM is unavailable or rate-limited
criteria.how_to_test: Verify fallback behavior: timeouts, circuit breakers, default responses, or graceful error messages when LLM fails

criteria.criterion: Token and cost estimates are documented for LLM-heavy code paths
criteria.how_to_test: Check for cost annotations, budget tracking, or documentation estimating per-call and aggregate token costs
